title: Special Executive Masters Programme In Economics
description: The Special Executive Master Programme (SEMP) in Economics is a comprehensive course designed for Economic professionals aiming to excel in economic strategy, market analysis, and decision-making across diverse market landscapes.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and Rushford Business School
longDescription: The Special Executive Master Programme (SEMP) in Economics emphasizes advanced economic theories and their application in market analysis, focusing on strategic decision-making and performance evaluation across diverse market structures. The Programme offers an efficient approach beyond traditional classroom learning. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The Special Executive Master Programme in Economics allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The program effectively prepares learners to tackle complex operational challenges by integrating theoretical knowledge with practical applications. This programme aims to deliver a practical and realistic solution to Economic challenges, supported by appropriate reference to theoretical and conceptual analysis.
courseDetails: The objective of the SEMP in Economics course is to equip participants with advanced skills and knowledge in economic strategy, market analysis, and decision-making to excel in various market environments. This qualification reflects current practices in Economics and allows learners to develop and expand their high-level understanding of Economics issues. Course Details: Economics in Healthcare: Understanding the economic principles and dynamics within the healthcare sector, including cost analysis, healthcare financing, and policy implications. Business Economics: Exploring the application of economic theories and concepts to business decision-making, including demand analysis, pricing strategies, and market structures. Global Business Enterprises: Analyzing the economic factors influencing global business operations, including international trade, multinational corporations, and foreign exchange markets. Business Management: Developing skills in business management, including strategic planning, organizational behavior, and financial management principles. Socioeconomic and Legal Framework: Examining the socioeconomic and legal factors shaping business environments, including regulatory frameworks, corporate social responsibility, and ethical considerations. Research Methods: Introduction to research methodologies relevant to economics and business, including quantitative and qualitative techniques, data analysis, and research design. Assessment: Graduation Project (GP) Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project(GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification embodies current practices in Economics and helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

entry: There are no strict entry requirements for this course. Work experience will be added advantage to understanding the content of the course.
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There are no Visa Requirements for this Programme.

modules.title: ECONOMICS IN HEALTHCARE
modules.summary: Healthcare economics is a branch of economics that focuses on the allocation, distribution, and utilization of healthcare resources. It examines how healthcare services are financed, delivered, and evaluated to improve the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the healthcare system.

lessons.title: Understanding the Principles of Healthcare Economics
Introduction to Managerial Economics & Demand Analysis and Estimation

modules.title: GLOBAL BUSINESS ENTERPRISES
modules.summary: The course on Global Business Enterprises covers international business environment, trade, investment, marketing, and supply chain management. It develops skills for cross-cultural communication, legal and economic factors impacting business operations, and strategies for market entry and expansion.

lessons.title: Nature of Multinational Enterprises & Their Role In Globalisation
Business of Foreign Markets and Their Impact on Business Decisions
Understanding Economic Blocks and Consequences of this Development

modules.title: BUSINESS MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The Business Management module is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the key principles and practices of modern business management. The module covers various aspects of management, including strategic planning, organizational design, leadership, human resource management, financial management, and operations management. It explores how businesses can create and sustain a competitive advantage through effective management practices and how managers can make informed decisions to achieve business objectives. Through case studies and real-world examples, students will develop the knowledge and skills required to manage and lead successful businesses in a dynamic and rapidly changing business environment.

lessons.title: Planning for and Operating a Business

modules.title: SOCIO-ECONOMIC AND LEGAL FRAMEWORK
modules.summary: The Socio-Economics and Legal Framework course covers the interplay between economic, social, and legal factors in contemporary societies. It examines poverty, inequality, social justice, and human rights, and explores how legal frameworks regulate economic activities. Through case studies, students develop critical thinking and analytical skills to analyze complex issues and develop informed solutions for sustainable development.

lessons.title: Understanding Socioeconomics Factors and their Impact on Business
Understanding the Socio-economic Dynamics and Obligations of a Business
Socio-economic Rights, Economic Crisis, and Legal Doctrine​
Understanding the Governance and Legal Framework of Business Environment
Contractual Dynamics of the Business Environment

modules.title: RESEARCH METHODS
modules.summary: The Research Methods module covers research design, data collection, and analysis using various methodologies. It explores ethical considerations and the use of technology. Through practical exercises, students develop skills in research planning, data analysis, and report writing. The module aims to equip students with the knowledge and skills required to conduct and evaluate research independently.

VIDEO - How to write a Literature Review
